description: Use the target environment available to the operator to identify the structured live hand/state feed, latency, identity mapping, lifecycle, and failure behavior; document the supported adapter boundary without OCR assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: ADR identifies exact available data source and permission assumptions.
Prototype captures a sanitized fixture stream for deterministic tests.
If no stable structured feed exists, live integration remains blocked while post-session functions proceed.

planning.title: Prove target-environment live data adapter contract
